== Description ==
'''GAMMA-1''' is the 2nd variant of [[SHA-1]], being admin-exclusive

== Behavior ==
Upon spawning, will highlight random lockers in green, however it will highlight most of the lockers across the entire section, likely to not leave a hiding spot for you, and will rush to the main room faster than [[SHA-1]], and will also check lockers faster than [[SHA-1]].

== Strategy & Tips ==
* Just hide in non-highlighted lockers or in safe spots.
* And don't get tricked by it's green indicating highlight, do not hide in there, it's not an invite like [[M-60i]].
